name: R076-hi-jump-kick-miss-ghost
why: Challenge 7. Player Medicham (373) uses Hi Jump Kick every turn against a Ghost lead (Dusclops 476: Toxic, Confuse Ray, Double Team, Protect; it cannot hurt Medicham quickly): the kick does no damage to a Ghost, so a miss (10 percent a turn, more with Double Team or Protect) takes the 'at least 1' floor of DMG_RECOIL_FROM_MISS.
